svg.title: Lakebase persona fighter portraits — options sheet one
svg.desc: Two original 8-bit portrait directions each for Backfill Bill, Stacktrace Jack, Count Query, Major Pattern, and Doctor Drift.
svg.text: PICK A OR B FOR EACH FIGHTER · THE ROLE ALWAYS APPEARS BELOW THE NAME

g.text: Repairs the failing frame in place
Refuses a claim until rows reconcile
Turns every boast into one checked number
Drills every team onto one standard
Nothing is the same size next round
The score changes before your eyes
